title: Session recall artifact (.session-recall.json)
description: The surfaced-set for memory auto-capture (PRD prd-memory-autocapture-2026-07-04, finding-5). Records which memories were surfaced (recalled) per session so the Stop-hook capture knows the candidate set. Producer: SessionStart surface scripts via session_recall.record_surfaced. Consumer: memory_autocapture.py via read_recall, then clear_session. Gitignored, session-scoped. On-disk shape is a MAP keyed by session_id so overlapping sessions never mix or truncate each other; each value is one per-session record.

session_id.description: The Claude session id this record belongs to. Matches the map key.

surfaced.description: The memories recalled this session, de-duplicated by memory_id.

memory_id.description: Flat slug of an in-scope memory (v1 scores only q-system/memory).

source_file.description: The memory's source file (usually <slug>.md); capture checks whether it was read this session.

surfaced_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the memory was surfaced.
